_README: SOCIAL-TAPE-001 — EXAMPLE source universe. This file is documentation.
It is NOT loaded by anything. The live universe in this repository is
a precondition for activation, alongside a configured monthly cost cap
The selectors below are deliberately placeholders (EXAMPLE_*). Copying
this file does not configure a universe; it shows the SHAPE of one.
Design target: 100-300 named rules whose individual value is being
measured. Every rule must carry a rationale you could defend when asked
to retire it, and an active_from you could condition a statistic on.
Rules are RETIRED (active_until), never deleted, so that tape collected
under an older universe stays interpretable.

rules.rationale: Venue listing announcements are a scheduled, attributable information event with a known publisher.
Launchpad accounts publish graduation and migration events that have an on-chain counterpart we can align against.
Protocol accounts announce integrations and incidents that move attention across many entities at once.
Named individually rather than as a bucket so this account's contribution can be measured and this account alone retired.
Address-shaped strings are the only text form that can be aligned to an on-chain entity without a name lookup.
Listing and migration vocabulary marks a state change with a definite on-chain or venue counterpart.
Incident vocabulary marks the negative tail, which is the half of the distribution an attention-driven universe otherwise under-samples.
